text:
```yaml
name: OSV Vulnerability Scan

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  osv-scan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Dart
      uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@v1
      with:
        sdk: 'stable'

    - name: Analyze code
      run: flutter analyze

    - name: Format code
      run: dart format .

    - name: Run OSV Scanner
      uses: anchore/scan-action@1638637db639e0ade3258b51db49a9a137574c3e
      with:
        image: gleeecbtc/gleec-wallet:latest
        path: .
        fail-build: true
        severity-cutoff: medium
```
